newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-RTW lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-RTW lowered to hold.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said it reduced its rating on RTW Inc to hold from buy after the company posted lower-than-expected fourth-quarter results.
--Analyst J. Chris Sergeant also said in a report he lowered his earnings per share estimate to $0.54 a share from $1 for 1997 and to $0.85 from $1.25 for 1998.

--"A spike in claims costs driven by several large claims in the quarter, the resulting change in reserving practices and problems with claims management in the Colorado market all combined to create the shortfall," Sergeant noted.
